verdict.rationale: Featurebase claims AI helps 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities' (docs-7) and offers AI search answers (docs-14) and an AI support agent (docs-10), suggesting some AI-driven feedback analysis, but there is no explicit evidence of automatic insight detection or automatic linking of feedback to related feature ideas. Missing for 10: documentation of duplicate/similarity detection, insight extraction from feedback text, and automatic linking mechanics to roadmap items.
